test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the information carefully and identify the correct relationship between the persons mentioned in the question.

Ravi is the son of Pooja.

Pooja is the daughter-in-law of Shyam.

Shyam is the father of Karan.

Question: How is Karan related to Ravi?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) Ravi is the son of Pooja.

2) Pooja is the daughter-in-law of Shyam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6b2a351afde48be0065563cb7b9e0400c9b420b2be21b5f850487b3fe785b9f.png] 

3) Shyam is the father of Karan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edbc5856263106dcb8977011701e2779b8076384c0bf726dff50cc35d3273b7e.png] 

Thus, Karan is Ravi's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
